bypass_street_side_leg.description: Flag to bypass street side leg. If true, we will not send the street side to the custodian.

bypass_trade_booking.description: Flag to bypass trade booking. If true, the trade will not be booked in the system.

counterparty_clearing_firm_id.description: DTC ID of the counterparty's clearing firm.

counterparty_id.description: MPID of the counterparty involved in the street trade.

execution_id.description: Trade ID. Often times this will be the ID of the execution made at an external venue.

external_trade_report_id.description:
Optional external trade report ID. If provided, this ID will be used instead of auto-generating one.
Must start with 'etr_' followed by a valid ULID.
If not provided, the system will generate a unique ID automatically.

price.description: The trade price. For mutual funds, if not provided, the backend will use the parent order's estimated price (NAV).

settle_date.description: The settlement date for the trade.

snapshot_id.description: Optional quote snapshot ID. If provided, this snapshot ID will be used instead of creating a new one.

trade_time.description: The timestamp when the trade occurred.

OrderSize.title: Amount
OrderSize.description:
The Amount of an order with a specified `type` indicating how the amount is represented.
- **Par:** Represents the order size in face value (e.g., a corporate bond with a $1,000 face value).
- **Notional:** Represents the order size in notional dollar value.
- **Shares:** Represents the order size in number of shares (for equities).
